source: DECISIONS.md Table 4 (S-01 to S-66, register v3 of 2026-10-19 and its 2026-10-20 row S-66) and W-29. Statuses are a copy: update a row's status here when Table 4 changes (for example when the Haiku pass applies S-01); status_table4 holds the register's own Status cell for the record. When Table 4 grows, add the rows and their patterns here in the same pass and re-cut scripts/stale_baseline.json the same day; --self-test fails when a Table 4 id has no row, when a status disagrees with the register, and when the O-row bound is behind the register. Amended 2026-10-20 (week-2 close-out, on the orchestrator's instruction): S-65 status copy set to applied (Table 4); two W-29 patterns for the retired phone figures '4 Mb/s' (PH2 cap) and '36 characters' (phone caption line) after the register's W-63 and W-18 amendment, with the allowlist entries AL-6a to AL-6e for their history. Amended again 2026-10-20 (package w2t-t2-wording, g, on the orchestrator's instruction): the two W-29 phone patterns now sit under the register's new row S-66 (applied), which has its own row here; the W-29 row no longer carries the phone figures. The allowlist entries AL-6a to AL-6e name S-66 for the same reason.
dialect: Python re. Matched per line. flags is '' or 'i'. FAIL = unambiguous stale value; WARN = needs a human. Optional per pattern: 'attribute' (a name in 'attributions', or a list) picks the Table 4 row by file, first match wins, else row_id; 'only_files' limits the pattern to files matching any of the globs; 'register_prefix' + 'register_last' tie a pattern to the register's last row (checked by --self-test).

exclude_reasons.build/: the plan and evidence quote the stale strings on purpose
exclude_reasons.scripts/stale_*: this tool's own pattern, allowlist and baseline files quote the stale strings on purpose
exclude_reasons.ops/decisions.csv: generated mirror of DECISIONS.md, which quotes every stale value by design (deviation from the plan's list, which names ops/ whole)
exclude_reasons.tests/: test fixtures quote the stale strings on purpose
exclude_reasons.scripts/public_lint.py: WP-03's theme guard: its docstring and keyword list (scripts/public_lint.config.json) name the retired theme and tool words on purpose, as scripts/stale_* do
